pairs.why: Nearly identical watches, but A's richer gold and deeper green with a vignette match the saturated, punchy finish of the real cards slightly better than B's paler, flatter look.
Same build in both; A has a slightly fuller, more saturated gold case and stronger contrast with the background, closer to the real ring box and scarf.
Practically identical; B's small grounding shadow and A's slightly richer gold offset each other, so neither is clearly closer.
A's bolder gold rim and deeper background tones read closer to the vivid, soft-plastic gloss of the real cards; B looks a little washed out.
A's case has slightly more volume and warmer, saturated gold, matching the real cards, while B is a touch flatter and lighter.
B's lighter, hazier background and flatter gold drift from the real cards' strong saturation; A keeps the richer contrast.
Nearly the same image; A's slightly deeper gold shading gives it the softer, chunkier depth of the real cards by a hair.
Both watches share the same construction, gloss level and color, so neither is meaningfully closer to the real cards.
